skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — generate a new video in the same style, pacing, and tone as this example —...

latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches the "video-generation-like" skill to generate new videos matched to the style, pacing, and tone of an example reference clip.
- Supports upload of major video formats (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI, etc.) up to 500MB.
- Handles automatic cloud-based style matching and rendering; all edits processed on remote GPU nodes.
- Includes guided onboarding, automatic setup, free trial credits, and session management.
- Exposes actions for upload, export, credits checking, and session state viewing.
- Provides clear error handling, command routing, and concise UI feedback for a seamless, code-free editing workflow.
